scoring_justification: T1 recompute from raw XAS/XMCD spectra not possible because the reference solve.sh does not output those files; therefore the checker validates the reported total_magnetic_moment against the paper‑reported gold (1.6 μB/Co ±0.2 μB/Co) and enforces structural relations.

hidden_assets.purpose: hidden gold for Co magnetic moment (total_magnetic_moment) from cluster-model calculation
hidden_assets.source_provenance: paper: 'The magnetic moment obtained from cluster-model calculation (Fig.3) is 1.6 μB/Co.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: directly taken from the paper text
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: matches the paper's stated cluster-model result

outputs.description: Co magnetic moment per ion computed from XMCD sum rules. The hidden verifier compares the submitted total_magnetic_moment against a hidden reference value with a tolerance of ±0.2 μB/Co and checks structural sanity: spin_moment > 0 and orbital_moment < spin_moment.

output_contract.notes: Only magnetic_moment.json is directly scored by the verifier; raw XAS and XMCD spectra are not inspected.

steps.description: Validate total_magnetic_moment against paper-reported value (exact_match within tolerance), and enforce spin_moment>0, orbital_moment<spin_moment.
